eras.note: Assumed decennial map preceding the current one; this project's data begins in 2016, so its earlier years are outside the checked range.

eras.label: current
eras.note: The 2025 mid-decade redistricting special session redrew only the congressional map; Senate lines are unchanged. Terms are staggered (half of 31 seats every 2 years) except the election right after each decennial redistricting, when all 31 are elected together and then draw lots to re-stagger.

redistricting.text: Kept 92% of its population from the 2016–2020 SD-1; gained the rest from the old SD-2 (8%). Counties: gained Hopkins (4%), Fannin (4%). 2020 presidential margin R+47.8 on the 2016–2020 lines → R+49.0 on the current lines.

A new footprint: only 49% of its population was in the 2016–2020 SD-2; it draws from the old SD-16 (23%), the old SD-8 (15%), the old SD-22 (14%). Counties: gained Collin (10%), Ellis (8%), Navarro (6%); lost Hunt, Hopkins, Fannin. 2020 presidential margin R+19.8 on the 2016–2020 lines → R+15.4 on the current lines.

Kept 80% of its population from the 2016–2020 SD-3; gained the rest from the old SD-4 (20%). Counties: gained Jefferson (20%); lost Montgomery, San Jacinto. 2020 presidential margin R+57.8 on the 2016–2020 lines → R+46.9 on the current lines.

Kept 72% of its population from the 2016–2020 SD-4; gained the rest from the old SD-7 (15%), the old SD-3 (9%), the old SD-15 (4%). Spans Montgomery, Harris, Jefferson, Chambers counties. 2020 presidential margin R+32.3 on the 2016–2020 lines → R+31.0 on the current lines.
